fullPassage:
Volunteering has a great deal of benefits. Not only do you make a positive impact on someone's life, but you gain valuable skills for your career. It even reduces stress and anxiety. With busy schedules, it can be hard to find the time to commit to volunteer work. These days, however, you can make a huge difference in the lives of others from your own home by virtually volunteering. Here are a few ways to virtually volunteer.
First, you could be a part of the effort to lend support to senior citizens who struggle with loneliness. Typically, volunteer "phone friends" make regular calls to chat and check in with these people. Second, you can help people with low or no vision with their everyday tasks. Through a live video call, you can offer visual assistance to those who need it with tasks such as reading "use by" dates and instructions on food packages, which helps them to lead more independent lives. Finally, if you have an interest in wildlife and its conservation, you can help with animal monitoring work by watching live videos of animal habitats around the world. Monitoring these animals helps protect wildlife and develop methods of conserving them.
Helping others and giving back to the community can be very rewarding. It can make your day more meaningful and productive. It is also a great way to connect with new people and cultures. For those who believe in karma, if you do good things for others, good things will happen to you!

questions.passage: Volunteering has a great deal of benefits. Not only do you make a (A)[positive / negative] impact on someone's life, but you gain (B)[valuable / worthless] skills for your career. It even reduces stress and anxiety. With busy schedules, it can be hard to find the time to (C)[commit / refuse] to volunteer work. These days, however, you can make a huge difference in the lives of others from your own home by virtually volunteering. Here are a few ways to virtually volunteer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 누군가의 삶에 긍정적인(positive) 영향을 미치고, 귀중한(valuable) 기술을 습득하며, 자원봉사에 전념할(commit) 시간을 내기 어렵다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① positive — valuable — commit: 원문 일치
❌ ② negative(부정적): 봉사의 이점을 설명하는 맥락
❌ ③ worthless(무가치한): valuable의 반의어
❌ ④ refuse(거부하다): commit의 반의어
det.tip: positive ↔ negative, valuable ↔ worthless, commit(전념하다) ↔ refuse(거부하다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 다른 사람을 돕는 것은 매우 보람 있고(rewarding), 하루를 더 의미 있게(meaningful) 만들 수 있으며, 새로운 사람과 이어지는(connect) 좋은 방법이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① rewarding — meaningful — connect: 원문 일치
❌ ③ meaningless(무의미한): meaningful의 반의어
❌ ② exhausting(지치는): rewarding의 반의어 맥락
❌ ④ disconnect(단절하다): connect의 반의어
det.tip: rewarding(보람 있는) ↔ exhausting(지치는), meaningful(의미 있는) ↔ meaningless(무의미한), connect(연결하다) ↔ disconnect(단절하다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 외로움으로 힘들어하는(struggle) 노인들에게 정기적으로(regular) 전화하고, 시각적 도움(assistance)을 제공한다.
det.analysis:

❌ ② thrive(번영하다): struggle의 반의어. 외로움에 번영하는 것은 모순

det.tip: struggle with(~로 힘들어하다) ↔ thrive(번영하다), regular(정기적인) ↔ irregular(불규칙적인), assistance(도움) ↔ resistance(저항)

❌ ① benefits: 원문 일치. 봉사의 많은 이점
❌ ② valuable: 원문 일치. 경력에 귀중한 기술

det.tip: independent(독립적인) ↔ dependent(의존적인). 동의어: autonomous, self-sufficient, self-reliant

questions.passage:
Volunteering has a great <u>deal</u> of benefits. Not only do you make a positive impact on someone's life, but you gain valuable skills for your career. It even reduces stress and anxiety. With busy schedules, it can be hard to find the time to commit to volunteer work. These days, however, you can make a huge difference in the lives of others from your own home by virtually volunteering. Here are a few ways to virtually volunteer.
First, you could be a part of the effort to lend support to senior citizens who struggle with loneliness. Typically, volunteer "phone friends" make regular calls to chat and check in with these people. Second, you can help people with low or no vision with their everyday tasks. Through a live video call, you can offer visual assistance to those who need it with tasks such as reading "use by" dates and instructions on food packages, which helps them to lead more independent lives. Finally, if you have an interest in wildlife and its conservation, you can help with animal monitoring work by watching live videos of animal habitats around the world. Monitoring these animals helps protect wildlife and develop methods of conserving them.
Helping others and giving back to the community can be very rewarding. It can make your day more meaningful and productive. It is also a great way to connect with new people and cultures. For those who believe in karma, if you do good things for others, good things will happen to you!
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 deal이 (A)와 (B)에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 많은 양(deal)의 이점이 있다. (B) 좋은 거래(deal)를 제안했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 양/정도 — 거래: (A) 'a great deal of'에서 deal은 '양/정도', (B) 'a good deal'에서는 '거래/흥정'
❌ ② 의미 뒤바뀜
❌ ① (B)는 상품 구매 맥락이므로 거래
❌ ④ (A)는 a great deal of(많은)이므로 양
det.tip: deal: ① a great deal of = 많은(양), ② a deal = 거래/합의(make a deal), ③ 처리하다(deal with)

questions.stem:
다음 영영 풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"the protection of plants, animals, and natural areas, especially from the damaging effects of human activity"

det.korean: 식물, 동물, 자연 지역을 인간 활동의 피해로부터 보호하는 것 → conservation(보존)
det.analysis:
✅ ④ conservation(보존/보호): 정의와 정확히 일치
❌ ① migration(이동/이주): 보호가 아닌 이동
❌ ③ pollution(오염): 보호의 반대 개념
❌ ② evolution(진화): 보호와 다른 개념
det.tip: conservation(보존) = 자연환경/야생동물을 보호하고 보존하는 활동. conserve(동사) → conservation(명사)

questions.passage: If you have an interest in wildlife and its conservation, you can help with animal monitoring work by watching live videos of animal habitats around the world. Monitoring these animals helps protect wildlife and develop methods of __________ (conserve) them.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: 이러한 동물들을 보존할(conserving) 방법을 개발하는 데 도움이 된다.
det.analysis: conserve → conserving. 전치사 of 뒤에 동명사(-ing) 형태. 'methods of conserving' = 보존하는 방법들
det.tip: 전치사 + -ing: methods of conserving(보존하는 방법), ways of helping(돕는 방법). of 뒤에는 동명사

questions.passage: Not only do you make a positive impact on someone's life, but you gain valuable skills for your career. It even reduces stress and anxiety. __________ (help) others and giving back to the community can be very rewarding.
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: 다른 사람을 돕는 것(Helping)과 지역 사회에 환원하는 것은 매우 보람 있다.
det.analysis: help → Helping. 문장의 주어 자리에 동명사(-ing) 형태. 'Helping others and giving back'이 주어. 문두이므로 대문자
det.tip: 동명사 주어: Helping others(다른 사람을 돕는 것) + and giving back(환원하는 것) = 복합 주어. 동명사가 주어일 때 단수 취급

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 정기적으로 전화를 걸어 대화를 나누고 안부를 확인한다(check in).
det.analysis:
✅ ① check in(안부를 확인하다): 원문 일치. chat and check in = 대화하고 안부 확인

❌ ③ argue(논쟁하다): 지원하는 맥락과 반대
❌ ④ move away(이사하다): 전화 통화 맥락과 무관
det.tip: check in (with someone) = ~의 안부를 확인하다/살펴보다. 병원/호텔 체크인과 다른 의미

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 당신의 집에서도 다른 사람들의 삶에 큰 변화(difference)를 줄 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② difference(차이/변화): 'make a huge difference'(큰 변화를 만들다) 관용 표현
❌ ① mistake(실수): make a mistake는 가능하나 'huge + in the lives'와 어울리지 않음
❌ ③ profit(이익): 봉사의 맥락에서 이익 추구는 부적절
❌ ④ demand(요구): make a demand는 가능하나 맥락과 맞지 않음
det.tip: make a difference = 변화를 만들다/차이를 만들다. make a huge difference = 큰 변화를 가져오다. 봉사/사회공헌 맥락에서 매우 자주 사용
